exchanges: hey so the boiler is making that noise again
Oh no, the clanking one? Have you told the landlord yet, or is it worth giving it a day to see if it settles?
not yet mr adeyemi never picks up before noon lol
Ha, a late riser then. Maybe a text so there's a record of when you reported it.
good idea. maria made coffee for everyone this morning which was nice
That's a lovely way to start the day. Is she usually the early one in the house?
yeah shes up at 6 every day feeding the lizard thing. she's got a gecko in her room, its called biscuit
Biscuit is a great name for a lizard. Does it need a heat lamp and all that?
ya a whole tank setup with lamps. luca thinks its creepy
Fair, not everyone loves reptiles. Is Luca the one who's always up late?
yeah hes doing architecture at uni so hes always building tiny models at 2am
That explains the late nights; model-making takes forever. Hopefully he isn't gluing things on the kitchen table.
he totally is lmao theres foam board everywere
The classic shared-house struggle. Maybe a spare corner could become his workspace.
ruth said the same thing. shes the most organised of all of us
Every house needs one of those. Does Ruth usually end up sorting the bills too?
yes shes the bill queen. anyway the guy upstairs kenji was practising his saxophone again til like 11
That's late for a weeknight. Is it loud enough to hear through the ceiling clearly?
oh def. its not terrible tho hes pretty good
That helps a bit, at least it's music and not just scales. Maybe a polite chat about a cutoff time?
maybe. went to hassans shop earlier for milk
The corner shop? Handy to have one so close.
yeah its open til midnight. his son was behind the till, hes home from uni, he does pharmacy in manchester
Nice, that's a demanding course. Must be good for Hassan to have him around for a bit.
hassan was beaming lol. also i saw maria from the laundrette, not my housemate maria the other one
Two Marias, that could get confusing. How's the laundrette one doing?
good she had her parrot on her shoulder again, it says hello to evryone
A greeting bird must be great for business. Customers probably come in just for that.
it really is. ok so i texted mr adeyemi about the boiler
Good, now it's on record. Did he reply yet?
he said hes sending someone thursday
That's not too bad. Hopefully the hot water holds out until then.
fingers crossed. oh wait i was wrong before, kenji's thing isnt a sax its a trombone, i saw him carrying the case today and its huge with the slide
Ah, the slide gives it away. That would explain how much it carries through the floor.
haha yeah. ruth is making a rota for the bins
Sounds like a good plan, rotas save a lot of arguments.
we'll see if luca follows it
Ha, maybe put his name next to the easy weeks first.
lol true. im so tired today
Long day? Maybe an early night is in order.
ya but theres a new girl moving in next door tonight so its noisy
Moving day is always chaos. Have you met her yet?
briefly, her names Ines, she just came over from Porto for a job at the hospital
That's a big move. She'll probably appreciate a friendly face on the street.
yeah i might bring her some cookies
That's a kind welcome. Homemade or from the shop?
from the shop obvs i cant bake
Nothing wrong with that, shop ones are often better anyway.

where's the new neighbour from originally
